format: NDCA Sanctioned events, Final round size

source.registry_document: 2026 June - Compiled Rule Book Master v1 - reduced size.pdf
source.section: IV.C.1.b, IV.C.1.f, IV.C.1.g, IV.C.2 (p.27); III.D.34 (Pro/Am multiple competitions)
source.quote_free_summary: Final size is capped at eight (IV.C.1.b, IV.C.2), yet IV.C.1.f says only the selected number dances except in the case of a tie; IV.C.1.g gives Amateur Cabaret/Formation exceptions; III.D.34 limits couples judged at once in multi-competition Pro/Am floors and (III.D.34.c) allows up to ten on the floor after a late registration or entry change when at least two entries are uncontested.

requirement: Enforce an eight-couple Final cap ONLY AFTER the IV.C.1.f / IV.C.2 / IV.C.1.b conflict is reconciled by the owner, including tie and event-format exceptions (IV.C.1.g, III.D.34).
enforcement_point: Not built. NDCA advancement support is NOT IMPLEMENTED and a BLOCKER to NDCA scoring-profile activation (OD-09). Docs-only record: nothing implemented, no test, no compliance claimed.
interpretation_notes: SOURCE CONFLICT (registry rule 3; recorded in governing-body-source-registry.md): IV.C.2 and IV.C.1.b read as an absolute cap while IV.C.1.f lets a tie exceed the selected number. Fails closed: no cap behavior is claimed and none is chosen here. Tie handling also depends on the undefined NDCA Skating System algorithm (OD-24). III.D.34 is a floor-capacity rule for Pro/Am multi-competition heats, not a Final cap; its relation to Final size is an interpretation question for the owner.
decision_refs: OD-09 (owner decision 2026-11-23, Option C now / Option A required for a future NDCA scoring profile; retrospective audit PR #795)
